_doc: Decoded spec-pair streams behind the muse /api/v1 REST API. Each stream is a list of {member_name_idx, type_name_idx} pairs decoded through the name table at 0x10f97094; 0xffffffff pairs terminate a stream. 'adjacent verb/param pool' lists the op names sitting next to the stream in rodata. Rendered to reference/muse_spec_streams.md by tools/gendocs.py.
